limitations_and_next_owner: B06: the generation-cycle witness proves one multi-point static-first fallback through the real N5→CAS→default-N8 route; it does not establish every registered engine, all input applicability combinations, production-data behavior, or a green affected-consumer aggregate.

B07: the coupling-only first rejection is reached on a one-point static NCM request. The compatible StockFlow producer clamps n_steps=0 to one and returns an extra t=1 state, while the consumer exposes only t=0; the baseline equals the initial stock and measured effect is zero. This is a selection/fallback and bounded consumer witness, not dynamic coupling behavior or effect authority.

The direct StockFlow oracle calls the same registered algorithm outside the N5 controller; it is not an independent scientific validation of the model, equations, units, calibration, or causal structure.
N8 remains value_conditional, simulate_only, and blocked from treating K_sim as world evidence; this evidence does not establish publishability or broader production orchestration.
